title: Fix esc undefined in the rate-type picker

input.requestedOutcome: agEditBuildRateTypePicker (~line 63783 of allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html) calls a bare esc(...) in the branch taken whenever the agent has a sales owner. No global esc exists in this file, so the picker throws ReferenceError and renders nothing for most agents. Add a local const esc per file convention, and grep every top-level render function for the same class of bug and report what is found.

output.summary: Added a local `const esc = s => String(s||'').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c]));` at the top of agEditBuildRateTypePicker (allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html), matching the exact convention already used one function above it in agEditBuildTmplPicker. This resolves the previously bare esc(_salesNm||'เซลล์ผู้ดูแล') call in the sales-owner hint branch, which threw ReferenceError: esc is not defined and rendered nothing for most agents. A file-wide sweep of all 3071 top-level functions found no other bare esc()/escapeHTML() call sites without a local declaration after this fix; the sweep script and methodology are documented in the report for reproducibility, and the tool was validated against the pre-fix backup (correctly flagged the known bug) and a set of legitimate multi-helper functions (bop2RenderShell family, no false positive once per-identifier scoping was corrected).

behaviorChanges.area: Agent Edit modal > Rate Type picker (agEditBuildRateTypePicker)
behaviorChanges.before: For any agent that has a sales owner set (the common case, non-noSales branch), the picker's hint text called a bare esc(_salesNm||'เซลล์ผู้ดูแล') with no esc defined anywhere in scope (esc/escapeHTML is not global in this file). This threw a synchronous ReferenceError inside the template literal, so agEditBuildRateTypePicker's return statement never completed and the Rate Type picker section rendered blank/broken for most agents opening Agent Edit.
behaviorChanges.after: agEditBuildRateTypePicker now declares its own local const esc (same HTML-escaping convention as the neighboring agEditBuildTmplPicker). The sales-owner hint renders correctly with the sales name (or 'เซลล์ผู้ดูแล' fallback) HTML-escaped, and the picker's rate-type list, hint text, and 'show other sales' toggle all render as designed.

decisions: Matched the existing per-function local-esc convention exactly (same escape map, same arrow-function shape) rather than introducing a shared/global esc helper, per CLAUDE.md's 'esc is not global — every new render fn must declare its own' rule and to avoid a structural change that could collide with LAM-17/18/19's concurrent edits to the same file.

Scoped the file-wide bug sweep to top-level `function NAME(){...}` declarations at column 0, since a check confirmed all render/build-style functions in this file use that pattern (only 2 top-level arrow-const declarations exist file-wide, neither named Render/Build-like), so this scope matches the task's ask to 'grep every top-level render function'.

Did not fix any of the other potential sites (none were found after correcting the sweep script's per-identifier scoping) — reported the sweep methodology and zero-result outcome instead of expanding this diff, per the explicit instruction to fix only agEditBuildRateTypePicker in this task.
risks: The brace-matching sweep script is a best-effort heuristic (handles strings/template literals/line+block comments but not all edge cases of nested template-literal ${...} expressions); it was validated against the known LAM-20 bug and against the bop2Render* family (multiple nested per-block escapeHTML declarations) with no false positive/negative in those cases, but a residual chance of an undetected site elsewhere in 3071 functions cannot be fully ruled out without a real JS parser (acorn/espree not available in this sandbox).

This task's diff was not exercised in a live browser/server session (no Postgres/network access from this sandbox), so the fix is verified by static analysis (node --check + convention match) only, not by an actual rendered-DOM click-through.
dependencies: LAM-17, LAM-18, LAM-19 edit allotment_v2/allotment_v2.html concurrently on sibling branches off the same base; merge conflicts against this PR are expected and accepted per task instructions, not something this worker resolves.
followUps: No other bare esc()/escapeHTML() call sites without a local declaration were found in any of the 3071 top-level functions in allotment_v2.html as of this task's HEAD, per the validated sweep script — no further follow-up fixes of this exact bug class are currently outstanding.

Recommended (not performed here): a lightweight lint/CI check that greps new top-level render functions for `esc(`/`escapeHTML(` usage without a matching local declaration, to catch this class of bug before merge in future PRs (per the recurring-gotcha note in CLAUDE.md section 6, 'esc / escapeHTML is NOT global').
